title: Gender Coreference and Bias Evaluation at WMT 2020
benchmark_measurement: This benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on gender coreference and bias in machine translation, specifically related to professional roles.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
